import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import defaultdict
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
rng=np.random.default_rng(11)
AAO="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"; AI={c:i for i,c in enumerate(AAO)}
B62="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
-1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
BM=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in B62.strip().split('\n')],float)
GOp,GE=-11.,-1.
def nw(s,t):
    m,n=len(s),len(t); NEG=-1e9
    S=np.array([[BM[AI[a],AI[b]] if a in AI and b in AI else -4. for b in t] for a in s])
    M=np.full((m+1,n+1),NEG);Ix=M.copy();Iy=M.copy();tb=np.zeros((m+1,n+1,3),np.int8);M[0,0]=0
    Ix[1:,0]=GOp+GE*(np.arange(1,m+1)-1); tb[1:,0,1]=1
    Iy[0,1:]=GOp+GE*(np.arange(1,n+1)-1); tb[0,1:,2]=2
    for i in range(1,m+1):
        M0,X0,Y0=M[i-1],Ix[i-1],Iy[i-1]
        st=np.stack([M0[:-1],X0[:-1],Y0[:-1]]);k=st.argmax(0);M[i,1:]=st[k,np.arange(n)]+S[i-1];tb[i,1:,0]=k
        st=np.stack([M0[1:]+GOp,X0[1:]+GE,Y0[1:]+GOp]);k=st.argmax(0);Ix[i,1:]=st[k,np.arange(n)];tb[i,1:,1]=k
        Mi,Xi,Yi=M[i],Ix[i],Iy[i]
        for j in range(1,n+1):
            v=(Mi[j-1]+GOp,Xi[j-1]+GOp,Yi[j-1]+GE);kk=int(np.argmax(v));Yi[j]=v[kk];tb[i,j,2]=kk
    i,j=m,n; st=int(np.argmax([M[m,n],Ix[m,n],Iy[m,n]])); pr={}
    while i>0 or j>0:
        p=int(tb[i,j,st])
        if st==0: pr[i]=j; i-=1; j-=1
        elif st==1: pr[i]=None; i-=1
        else: j-=1
        st=p
    return pr
seqs={}
for nm,acc in {'Yet1':'P35723','Yet2':'Q04210','Yet3':'Q07451','BAP29':'Q9UHQ4','BAP31':'P51572'}.items():
    seqs[nm]=''.join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:])
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
at=defaultdict(list)
for L in requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4JZP.pdb",timeout=60).text.split('\n'):
    if L.startswith(('ATOM  ','HETATM')) and L[17:20].strip() in AA3 and L[16] in ' A':
        at[L[21]].append((int(L[22:26]),np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])])))
ch=sorted(at); A,Bc=at[ch[0]],at[ch[1]]
D=np.linalg.norm(np.array([a[1] for a in A])[:,None]-np.array([b[1] for b in Bc])[None],axis=2)
NC=defaultdict(int)
for i,j in zip(*np.where(D<5.0)): NC[A[i][0]]+=1
IFACE=sorted(NC)
# ---- fungal PF05529 panel ----
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",timeout=60,params=dict(
    query="xref:pfam-PF05529 AND taxonomy_id:4751 AND reviewed:false AND length:[150 TO 320]",
    format="fasta",size=120)).text
fung=[]; cur=None
for L in r.split('\n'):
    if L.startswith('>'): 
        if cur: fung.append(cur)
        cur=['','']; cur[0]=L.split('|')[1] if '|' in L else L[1:]
    elif cur and L: cur[1]+=L
if cur: fung.append(cur)
kq=lambda s:{s[i:i+3] for i in range(len(s)-2)}
ref=kq(seqs['BAP31'][150:])
fung=sorted(fung,key=lambda x:-len(kq(x[1])&ref))[:20]
print(f"Fungal PF05529 panel: {len(fung)} sequences, lengths {min(len(f[1]) for f in fung)}-{max(len(f[1]) for f in fung)}")
# ---- per-interface-position coverage ----
cov={}; aa={}
for nm in ['BAP29','Yet1','Yet3','Yet2']:
    pr=nw(seqs['BAP31'],seqs[nm])
    cov[nm]=np.array([pr.get(p) is not None for p in IFACE])
    aa[nm]=[seqs[nm][pr[p]-1] if pr.get(p) else '-' for p in IFACE]
fcov=np.zeros(len(IFACE)); fid=np.zeros(len(IFACE))
for acc,s in fung:
    pr=nw(seqs['BAP31'],s)
    for k,p in enumerate(IFACE):
        j=pr.get(p)
        if j is not None:
            fcov[k]+=1
            if s[j-1]==seqs['BAP31'][p-1]: fid[k]+=1
fcov/=len(fung); fid/=len(fung)
# ---- Fisher: is interface coverage lower than protein-wide coverage? ----
print("\nCoverage of the 25 BAP31 interface positions versus the rest of the protein\n")
res=[]
for nm in ['BAP29','Yet1','Yet3','Yet2']:
    pr=nw(seqs['BAP31'],seqs[nm])
    rest=[p for p in range(1,len(seqs['BAP31'])+1) if p not in set(IFACE)]
    a=int(cov[nm].sum()); b=len(IFACE)-a
    c=sum(pr.get(p) is not None for p in rest); d=len(rest)-c
    orr,pv=fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d]])
    res.append({'protein':nm,'iface_cov':f"{a}/{len(IFACE)}",'iface_pct':round(100*a/len(IFACE),1),
                'rest_cov':f"{c}/{len(rest)}",'rest_pct':round(100*c/len(rest),1),
                'odds_ratio':round(orr,3),'fisher_p':f"{pv:.2e}"})
    print(f"{nm:6s} interface {a:2d}/{len(IFACE)} ({100*a/len(IFACE):5.1f}%)   rest of protein "
          f"{c:3d}/{len(rest)} ({100*c/len(rest):5.1f}%)   OR={orr:.3f}  Fisher p={pv:.2e}")
dfc=pd.DataFrame(res)
lost=[IFACE[k] for k in range(len(IFACE)) if not cov['Yet2'][k]]
kept=[IFACE[k] for k in range(len(IFACE)) if cov['Yet2'][k]]
mi={p:k for k,p in enumerate(IFACE)}
print(f"\nYet2p aligns to {len(kept)} interface positions: {kept}")
print(f"Yet2p has no aligned residue at {len(lost)}: {lost}")
print(f"\nFungal conservation (n={len(fung)}) at the positions Yet2p lacks vs those it keeps:")
print(f"  coverage  lacks {fcov[[mi[p] for p in lost]].mean():.2f}   keeps {fcov[[mi[p] for p in kept]].mean():.2f}")
print(f"  identity  lacks {fid[[mi[p] for p in lost]].mean():.2f}   keeps {fid[[mi[p] for p in kept]].mean():.2f}")
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
u,pu=mannwhitneyu(fid[[mi[p] for p in lost]],fid[[mi[p] for p in kept]])
print(f"  Mann-Whitney on fungal identity, lacked vs kept: U={u:.1f}, p={pu:.3f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,6.6),height_ratios=[2.1,1],sharex=True)
x=np.arange(len(IFACE))
for r_,nm in enumerate(['BAP29','Yet1','Yet3','Yet2']):
    for k in x:
        ok=cov[nm][k]
        ax[0].add_patch(plt.Rectangle((k-.45,-r_-.42),.9,.84,
            facecolor=('tab:green' if ok else '0.88'),alpha=.75 if ok else 1,edgecolor='w'))
        ax[0].text(k,-r_,aa[nm][k],ha='center',va='center',fontsize=7.5,
                   color='k' if ok else '0.55',fontweight='bold' if ok and aa[nm][k]==seqs['BAP31'][IFACE[k]-1] else 'normal')
for k in x: ax[0].text(k,1,seqs['BAP31'][IFACE[k]-1],ha='center',va='center',fontsize=8,fontweight='bold')
ax[0].set_ylim(-3.7,1.6); ax[0].set_xlim(-.7,len(IFACE)-.3)
ax[0].set_yticks([1,0,-1,-2,-3]); ax[0].set_yticklabels(['BAP31 (4JZP)','BAP29','Yet1p','Yet3p','Yet2p'],fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_title('The 25 BAP31 interchain interface positions of 4JZP, mapped by pairwise alignment\n'
                'grey = no aligned residue; bold = identical to BAP31',fontsize=10)
ax[1].bar(x-.2,fcov,.4,color='tab:blue',label='fungal coverage')
ax[1].bar(x+.2,fid,.4,color='tab:orange',label='fungal identity to BAP31')
for k in x:
    if not cov['Yet2'][k]: ax[1].axvspan(k-.5,k+.5,color='tab:red',alpha=.10)
ax[1].set_xticks(x); ax[1].set_xticklabels([str(p) for p in IFACE],rotation=90,fontsize=7.5)
ax[1].set_ylabel(f'fraction of {len(fung)} fungi'); ax[1].set_xlabel('BAP31 residue number')
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8); ax[1].set_ylim(0,1.05)
ax[1].set_title('Red shading = position Yet2p does not reach',fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
